correctness.rationale: On the projective full-coordinate torus write F=(prod x_i) sum_i u_i/(x_i x_{i+1}). Singular equations force alternating nonzero y_i=u_i/(x_i x_{i+1}), hence 4|n and equality of alternating coefficient products. Recurrent equations x_(i+2)=-(u_(i+1)/u_i)x_i have two free parity parameters with cyclic compatibility exactly balance, giving a punctured P1. At any such point the logarithmic Hessian is the weighted even-cycle adjacency with opposite alternating weights; its kernel is exactly the two-dimensional space of 2-periodic vectors, so rank n-2. Quotient by projective scaling leaves one critical-line direction and nondegenerate normal Hessian; analytic Morse-Bott splitting yields a smooth 1D factor times a quadratic node in n-2 variables, with reduced Jacobian scheme. The stronger earlier October 12 source independently verifies the same via inversion to an honest quadratic form, confirming the argument. No coordinate-boundary singularity claim.
